title: 第三章破限后的特性第四章变故
content_zh:
;;
【识文断字已达圆满，是否消耗10点源能完成识文断字的破限？】
看到这道提示的一刹那，江宁瞬间恍然大悟。
“原来如此！！原来源能点的作用在这！”
他心中在这一刻彻底明悟。
在这之前，随着面板的出现，源能这一栏随着每日时间的流逝，一到凌晨会自行增加0.1至0.3个数值。
之前他经过多方尝试，始终没有弄清楚面板上的源能点究竟有什么效果。
直到这一刻，他才彻底明白。
原来是当一门技艺达到圆满后，要想继续突破，则就要消耗源能点。
明白此事后，江宁心中再无任何迟疑，心念顿时一动。
面板上的源能点瞬间减少10点，而识文断字这门显示在面板上的技艺也开始发生变动。
江宁也瞬间感知到自己大脑中似乎有阵阵清灵之力流转，内心古井无波，阵阵空明。
他不由的闭上双目微微感受体内所发生的变化。
少顷，一切变化归于平静。
江宁也睁开双目，眼前浮现面板。
【名称】：江宁
【源能】：3.5
【技艺】：识文断字（一次破限02000）（特效：过目不忘）
“果然如此！！”他在心中喃喃自语。
如此变化并未出乎他的意料。

在这之前，他就注意到特效这两个字。
之前识文断字这门技艺从入门不断突破，每一次突破特效这一栏始终为空。
达到圆满后他心中就有一个猜测，那就是在圆满之后突破或许会有特效的出现，如今他的猜测成为现实，他心中自然不会有太大的意外。
【过目不忘】：记忆非凡者，过目不能忘。
旋即他一眼快速扫过四周的景象，此时尚且一息不到。
随后他闭上双目，刹那间，刚刚被他扫过的小院景色栩栩如生的出现在他脑海中，不论是蜜蜂扇动的翅膀，还是飘落在空中翻转的树叶，皆清晰入理的浮现在他脑海中。
“如此效果！！”江宁心中不由的暗暗惊叹。
这种效果，大大出乎他意料。
他如今所拥过的过目不忘不是文字，而是画面，清晰如纹理的画面，栩栩如生，可以动起来的画面。
“拥有过目不忘的加持，对于我学武同样极其有利！！”江宁心中顿时振奋不已。
在这個世界，学文参加科举之路可以做到朝为田舍郎，暮等天子堂，成为人上人的存在。
学武同样如此，参加武举之路可做到统兵百万，可封侯封王，甚至可开疆裂土。
而且武道之路可以一人成军，一人敌国，伟力尽归于身。
甚至可得长生！
根据他这些时日看过的书籍记载，大夏成功开国便是因为出了一位武圣，一位无敌的武圣。
而这位武圣镇压大夏国八百年气运。
也就是说，那位武圣从大夏开国之初存活至今，堪称神话，堪称传奇。
如今大夏王朝动荡不堪，在江宁看来也是与这位武圣数十年没有露面有所关联。
正是因为了解这些，所以江宁早已做出打算，文他要，武也要。

[Literacy and word recognition has reached perfection. Can I spend 10 points to complete the breakthrough of literacy and word recognition? 】
The moment he saw this prompt, Jiang Ning suddenly understood.
"I see! This is where the original energy point comes in!"
He understood completely at this moment.
Prior to this, with the appearance of the panel, the source energy column would increase by 0.1 to 0.3 as the day passed in the early morning.
After many attempts before, he still couldn't figure out the effect of the source energy points on the panel.
It wasn't until this moment that he fully understood.
It turns out that when a skill reaches perfection, if you want to continue to make breakthroughs, you have to consume source energy points.
After understanding this matter, Jiang Ning no longer had any hesitation in his heart, and his thoughts suddenly moved.
The source energy points on the panel instantly decreased by 10 points, and the skill of reading and deciphering words displayed on the panel also began to change.
Jiang Ning also instantly felt that there seemed to be waves of spiritual power flowing in his brain, and his heart was calm and empty.
He couldn't help but close his eyes and feel the changes happening in his body.
After a while, all changes returned to calm.
Jiang Ning also opened his eyes, and a panel appeared in front of him.
[Name]: Jiangning
[Source energy]: 3.5
[Skill]: Reading and hyphenation (breaking the limit of 02000 once) (Special effect: photographic memory)
"As expected!!" He murmured to himself.
Such a change did not surprise him.
Before that, he noticed the word special effects.
In the past, the art of reading and hyphenating has been constantly breaking through from the beginning, and the special effects column was always empty every time I made a breakthrough.
After reaching Consummation, he had a guess in his mind, that is, there might be special effects in the breakthrough after Consummation. Now that his guess has become a reality, he naturally won't be too surprised.
[Photographic memory]: Those with extraordinary memory have a photographic memory.
Immediately, he quickly glanced at the surrounding scene, this time without even breathing.
Then he closed his eyes, and in an instant, the scenery of the small courtyard he had just swept appeared vividly in his mind. Whether it was the flapping wings of bees or the turning leaves falling in the air, they all appeared clearly and logically in his mind.
"Such an effect!!" Jiang Ning could not help but secretly marvel.
This effect was far beyond his expectation.
The photographic memory he has now is not words, but pictures, pictures as clear as texture, pictures that are lifelike and can be moved.
"Having the blessing of photographic memory is also extremely beneficial for me to learn martial arts!!" Jiang Ning was suddenly excited.
In this world, those who study literature and participate in the imperial examination can achieve the goal of serving as a farmhouse minister in the morning, waiting for the emperor in the evening, and becoming a superior person.
The same is true for learning martial arts. By participating in the martial arts examination, one can command millions of troops, be granted the title of marquis and king, and even open up territories and split the land.
Moreover, in the path of martial arts, one person can form an army, and one person can defeat the country, and all the great power can be attributed to one person.
You can even live forever!
According to the records in the books he had read these days, the successful founding of Daxia was due to the emergence of a Martial Saint, an invincible Martial Saint.
And this Martial Saint suppressed the fate of the Great Xia Kingdom for eight hundred years.
In other words, the Martial Saint's survival from the beginning of the founding of the Xia Dynasty to this day can be called a myth and a legend.
The Great Xia Dynasty is now in turmoil, which in Jiang Ning's opinion is also related to the fact that the Martial Saint has not shown up for decades.
Precisely because he understood this, Jiang Ning had already made plans to get both the text and the force.
